description: Count strict integer lattice points in a bounded rational convex polygon using oriented Euclidean edge floor sums and exact vertex-column classification.

source.title: CP-Algorithms: Lattice points inside non-lattice polygon
source.algorithm_attribution: Oriented edge contributions evaluated by rational floor sums; integer vertex-x columns are classified directly with exact boundary and ray-crossing checks
source.implementation_status: clean-room implementation from the published algorithm description

input.coordinate_scale_rule: abs(x_num) <= 4*S and abs(y_num) <= 4*S, so physical coordinates lie in [-4,4]

output.encoding: number of strict interior integer lattice points

contract.polygon: vertices are distinct, listed in strict convex order, with no collinear triples; either winding is accepted
contract.rationality: at least one vertex coordinate is nonintegral
contract.interior_rule: points on any polygon edge or vertex are excluded
contract.integer_vertex_columns: excluded from half-open edge floor-sum spans and classified point-by-point at integer y-values from -4 through 4
contract.invalid_geometry: invalidates the whole frame and returns -1
contract.independent_method: enumerate integer points in the bounding box and use exact ray crossing

complexity.validation: O(N^3) exact orientation checks with N<=8
complexity.edge_count: O(N^2 log C) Euclidean floor-sum iterations because each edge span may split at up to N integer vertex-x columns
complexity.integer_vertex_x_columns: O(N^2) bounded exact point-in-polygon checks; at most N event columns and nine candidate integer y-values per event
